aggregation: mean of metrics across the selected configuration's seeds; configuration selection used development data

specification.question: how nnFoundation (CNN and ViT) and FlexiCT (3D teacher and the image tower of the 3D vision-language model) perform as frozen LUNA25 nodule classifiers under the project's established reference-field, local-field, descriptor and head standard, compared with the six existing encoders, the official LUNA25 I3D and the AutoMSC baseline

nnfoundation_cnn.architecture: ResEncL encoder (6 stages, 32-64-128-256-320-320 channels) built from the checkpoint adaptation plan with dynamic_network_architectures, encoder weights loaded strictly
nnfoundation_cnn.embedding: spatial mean of the last stage, as in the official classification code

nnfoundation_cnn_native.input: the provider crop at native spacing without resampling (128 x 128 x 64 voxels, median 0.66 x 0.66 x 2.0 mm, about 85 mm in plane), oriented to (S, P, L) and z-scored over the crop, as recommended for nnFoundation (z-score, no resampling)
nnfoundation_cnn_native.reason: with 64^3 inputs the last ResEncL stage has 2^3 positions, so its instance normalization works on 8 values per channel (6^3 for the recommended 192^3 patch); the native crop keeps 2 x 4 x 4 positions at the last stage and 4 x 8 x 8 at the penultimate one
nnfoundation_cnn_native.tokens: reference view: last stage (2 x 4 x 4); local view: penultimate stage (4 x 8 x 8) of the same input
nnfoundation_cnn_native.mid: reference view: penultimate stage; local view: stage 4 of 6 (8 x 16 x 16)
nnfoundation_cnn_native.embedding: spatial mean of the token stage

nnfoundation_vit.architecture: PrimusX (EVA, 40 blocks, embedding 1056, 16 heads, 8^3 patches) built from the checkpoint adaptation plan; absolute position embedding resized trilinearly from the 24^3 pretraining grid to the input grid as in the official classification code
nnfoundation_vit.tokens: final EVA output after the final norm
nnfoundation_vit.mid: output of block 30 of 40 with the final norm applied
nnfoundation_vit.embedding: mean of the final patch tokens, as in the official classification code

flexict_3d.architecture: FlexiCT ViT backbone (16 blocks, embedding 864, 12 heads, 8^3 patches, 3D RoPE, 4 storage tokens), teacher weights loaded with the official loader
flexict_3d.mid: output of block 12 of 16 with the final norm applied (official get_intermediate_layers)
flexict_3d.embedding: final normalized CLS token, the official image representation

flexict_vlm.architecture: vision tower of FlexiCT-3D-VLM (same backbone as flexict_3d after report alignment); vision_model weights loaded strictly, text tower unused
flexict_vlm.mid: output of block 12 of 16 with the final norm applied (official get_intermediate_layers)

specification.field_rule: nodule-centred physical crop at the provider crop centre, resampled with linear interpolation in LPS world coordinates and arranged as (S, P, L) arrays like SimpleITK; padding -1024 HU. Reference fields: 64 mm for nnFoundation, 72 mm at the 1.5 mm FlexiCT pretraining spacing. Local fields keep the tensor shape: 32 mm for nnFoundation, 50 mm for FlexiCT (spacing within 1.5x of pretraining, as for VISTA3D)
specification.normalization_rule: zscore: (x - mean) / std over the input field without clipping (nnU-Net ZScoreNormalization used for nnFoundation pretraining); clip_zscore: clip to [-1000, 1000] HU, then z-score over the input field (FlexiCT preprocessing)
specification.selection: development AUROC with log-loss tie break; neural learning rate chosen on seed 2025, neural rows compared by three-seed means, linear rows by their deterministic fit

layer_comparisons.question: which frozen FlexiCT layer and field of view give the best LUNA25 development discrimination with the project's max head, before FlexiCT enters the SAE exploration

two_field.rule: max head over the concatenated final-layer tokens of the 72 mm reference view and the 50 mm local view of the baseline suite (216 + 216 tokens)

layer_comparisons.field_rule: provider-centred physical crop, 48^3 tensor (patch 8, 6^3 tokens), spacing = field / 48 (0.83, 1.04 and 1.33 mm), HU clipped to [-1000, 1000] and z-scored over the field, as in the baseline suite
layer_comparisons.layer_rule: patch tokens after block b of 16 with the final norm applied (official get_intermediate_layers)
layer_comparisons.head: max
layer_comparisons.selection: each candidate (field, block) is fitted with seed 2025 at both learning rates and scored by its better development AUROC (log-loss tie break); the best candidate is repeated with seeds 2026 and 2027 and replaces the baseline selection only if its three-seed mean AUROC is higher

layer_comparisons.question: the best FlexiCT candidates of suite 20261017_flexict_improvement lie at the smallest field (40 mm) and the earliest block (10) of that grid; this extension tests a smaller field and earlier blocks before FlexiCT enters the SAE exploration
layer_comparisons.field_rule: provider-centred physical crop, 48^3 tensor (patch 8, 6^3 tokens), spacing = field / 48 (0.67 and 0.83 mm), HU clipped to [-1000, 1000] and z-scored over the field, as in the baseline suite
layer_comparisons.layer_rule: patch tokens after block b of 16 with the final norm applied (official get_intermediate_layers)
layer_comparisons.head: max
layer_comparisons.selection: as in 20261017_flexict_improvement; the final choice per model is the higher three-seed mean AUROC of the two suites' selected candidates, and it replaces the baseline selection only if higher than the baseline
